name: CCA 321 风挡裂纹 雷暴绕飞 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA 321, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11,600 meters, over DAPRO, squawking 3120, make initial contact with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 321，航班从北京飞往广州，保持 11,600 米，飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3120，首次联系广州管制。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, maintain present level, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，广州管制，雷达已识别，保持当前高度，取消位置报告。
cards.referenceText: maintain present level, omit position reports, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，取消位置报告，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: your weather radar indicates there is a group of cumulonimbus ahead, contact Guangzhou Control and ask to offset 20 miles to the right and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有一组积雨云，联系广州管制，请求向右偏置 20 英里并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Control, CCA 321, cumulonimbus, CB request offset 20 miles to the right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，CCA 321，积雨云，CB，请求向右偏置 20 英里。

cards.audioText: ask Guangzhou Control if you can offset 10 miles to the left to avoid the thunderstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问广州管制，是否可以向左偏置 10 英里以避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Control, CCA 321, request offset 10 miles to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 321，请求向左偏置 10 英里。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, negative due restricted area.
B: you ask if you can turn left heading 100 and descend to 11000m to avoid the thunderstorms.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 321，因限制区，不能批准。
B： 你询问是否可以左转航向 100，并下降至 11,000 米以避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Request turn left heading 100, descend to 11000 meters, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求左转航向 100，下降至 11,000 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, turn left heading 100 approved, descend to and maintain 11,000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，批准左转航向 100，下降至并保持 11,000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 100 approved, descend to and maintain 2000 meters 11000 meters, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准左转航向 100，下降至并保持 2,000 米、11,000 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: Now you are clear of weather, inform Guangzhou Control and request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已脱离天气，通知广州管制并请求直飞 ZF 和下降。
cards.referenceText: Control, CCA 321, clear of weather, request direct to ZF, descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 321，已脱离天气，请求直飞 ZF 并下降。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 9800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 9,800 米。
cards.referenceText: direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 9800, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 9,800 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: Suddenly your captain got incapacitated, possibly suffered from cardiac arrest, contact Guangzhou Control. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的机长突然失能，可能发生心脏骤停，联系广州管制。这是一次遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Guangzhou Control, CCA 321, our captain got incapacitated, possibly cardiac arrest.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，广州管制，CCA 321，我们的机长失能，可能发生心脏骤停。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, report your current situation and further intention.
B: Tell Guangzhou Control that the cabin crew offered CPR procedures and first aid to revive the captain, but he has difficulty in breathing, and request priority landing and medical services.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 321，报告你当前的情况和进一步意图。
B： 告诉广州管制，客舱机组对机长实施了心肺复苏和急救，试图使其恢复意识，但他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: the cabin crew offered CPR procedures, first aid, have difficulty in breathing, request priority landing, medical services, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 客舱机组实施了心肺复苏和急救，机长呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，右转，直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 6,000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，下降至并保持 6,000 米，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, inform your situation to Wuhan Approach and request priority landing and medical services.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 6000 米，向武汉进近说明情况并请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, our captain got incapacitated, he is having difficulty in breathing, request priority landing and medical services.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，CCA 321，过 ZF，保持 6000 米，我们的机长失能，他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。

cards.audioText: CCA 321, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 321，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 330，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, cleared ILS Runway 36R, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: During approach, you find the ILS signals seem to be unstable and your autopilot has malfunctioned, inform Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近期间，你发现 ILS 信号似乎不稳定，而且自动驾驶发生故障，通知武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, ILS signals, unstable, autopilot malfunctioned.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 321，ILS 信号不稳定，自动驾驶发生故障。

cards.audioText: At minimum altitude, you are unable to see the runway due to low visibility, you decide to divert to Changsha.
cards.audioTextZh: 在最低高度，由于能见度低，你无法看到跑道，因此决定备降长沙。
cards.referenceText: Approach, CCA 321, unable to see the runway, low visibility, request divert to Changsha.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，CCA 321，由于能见度低，无法看到跑道，请求备降长沙。

cards.audioText: During approach, the windshield suddenly had electrical arcing, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and request delay the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近期间，风挡突然出现电弧，向武汉进近报告情况并请求推迟进近。
cards.referenceText: Approach, CCA 321, windshield had electrical arcing, request delay the approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，CCA 321，风挡出现电弧，请求推迟进近。

cards.audioText: Now you find you have some errors with ILS, report it to Wuhan Approach and request auto-land.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现 ILS 存在一些误差，向武汉进近报告并请求自动着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, we have some errors with ILS, request auto-land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 321，我们的 ILS 存在一些误差，请求自动着陆。

cards.audioText: After landing, you can't find the taxiway due to shattered wind shield, request a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆后，由于风挡破碎，你无法找到滑行道，请求引导车。
cards.referenceText: Ground, CCA 321, can't find the taxiway, shattered wind shield, request follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，CCA 321，由于风挡破碎，无法找到滑行道，请求引导车。
